items.title: Part 4 – Cybersecurity journeys: What I’d tell my younger self
items.summary: Over the past few weeks, I’ve introduced you to people who fell into security from the most unexpected places, who work in domains you’ve probably never heard of, and who were honest about what the job is like after the excitement fades and the real work begins.
